Company: AutoControl Tech
Role: Automation and Control Engineer
Location: Remote (Spain)

About the Role:
We are developing advanced automation systems for smart manufacturing.

Responsibilities:
- Design and tune PID controllers.
- Implement PLC-based automation systems.
- Develop SCADA monitoring systems.
- Integrate industrial networks.

Required Skills:
- Control systems theory.
- PLC programming.
- SCADA systems.
- PID tuning.
- Industrial communication protocols.

Nice to Have:
- MATLAB/Simulink.
- OPC-UA.
- Industrial IoT knowledge.
